about.purpose.title: INTENDED USE
about.purpose.body: The tool inspects hardware configuration, Windows and Microsoft Office activation state, installed software and interference signals, then creates technical reports for users, technicians and administrators. Results reflect the scan time, separate activation state from entitlement, and do not replace invoices, agreements or license records.
about.model.title: OPERATING MODEL
about.model.body:
Every launch starts Offline. Inspection, analysis, Tool Assistant and report generation run locally, do not connect automatically and do not change the system. The user must explicitly enable Online mode for the current session when update checks, catalog sync or assistant-knowledge sync are needed; restarting returns to Offline.

System-changing operations run only after scope selection, preview, confirmation and Administrator elevation when genuinely required. Reports are never uploaded automatically; the assistant reads only safe summary fields from the current report.
about.technology.title: TECHNOLOGY & LANGUAGES
about.technology.body:
The application uses C#/.NET Framework 4, Windows Forms and PowerShell, compiled AnyCPU for 32-bit and 64-bit Windows. Data uses JSON, XML and CSV; reports use HTML/PDF; integrity uses SHA-256 and sensitive data uses DPAPI/HMAC.

Tool Assistant supports lookup, answers, and guidance for content within Tool Kiem Tra's scope, based on its knowledge base, user guides, and available report data. When Online, it only downloads the project's fixed JSON knowledge file, validates its structure and size, and caches it; questions, reports and machine data are never uploaded.

assurance.text.010:
A Valid state confirms the Authenticode signature at scan time. Chain validation uses the local certificate store without online revocation checks; integrated environments should perform OCSP/CRL validation separately when policy requires it.

A file-signing certificate does not by itself prove that Windows or Office is properly licensed; reconcile the licensing channel and purchase records as well.
assurance.text.012: Verify Authenticode signatures and trust chains for core Windows files, detected Office files, and the launcher.
assurance.text.023: Declarative read-only; plugin scripts and commands are never executed
assurance.text.024:
The engine supports only three read sources: registry values, files under Windows/Program Files/ProgramData, and Windows services. Fields outside the schema are rejected.

Plugins under ProgramData use an ACL that permits writes only by Administrators/SYSTEM. Plugin installation requires administrator confirmation and SHA-256 is verified after copying.
assurance.text.026: v4.6 plugins are declarative, read-only JSON and cannot contain PowerShell code, system commands, or network downloads.
